sheet.title: MULTILANE UNDIVIDED ROADWAY RIGHT LANE CLOSURE
sheet.provenanceNote: Tables, notes and legend are verbatim from the PDF vector text layer (PyMuPDF word extraction with coordinates). Layout anchors, lateral extents and symbol positions are measured from the drawing geometry and are marked confidence='drawing'. The NYSDOT catalog lists this sheet as both 1 and 2 sheets in different index pages; the repository PDF retrieved 2026-08-03 has 1 page.

annotationStyle.notes: Live prefs: length on dim only; name labels below sheet features; SHOULDER TAPER overlay on opposite side; ARROW PANEL label from compile_symbols. See sheet.buildGuide.

applicability.durationDefinition: Daytime work that occupies a location for more than 1 hour within a single daylight period (Note 1).

speedRangeMph.note: Table 311-02 has rows for 25/30/35/40/45/50/55 only. This sheet does NOT cover 60 or 65 mph. Reject or escalate a speed outside this range instead of extrapolating.

applicability.shoulderWidthBandNote: Table 311-02 has exactly three shoulder columns. Any shoulder width of 8 ft or more maps to the '>= 8 ft' band. Do not interpolate per-foot values between 8 and 12 ft — the sheet does not provide them.
applicability.areaTypeNote: Table 311-03 is keyed on URBAN vs RURAL and, for URBAN, on the preconstruction posted speed limit. Area type is a REQUIRED input for this sheet and is not derivable from speed alone.

tableRoles.note: Canonical role -> this sheet's table id. Generic tooling (sheet_spec.py, validate_sheet_spec.py) keys off these role names instead of literal '311-NN' strings, so the same code works on a sheet whose analogous table happens to be numbered differently, or that references a shared table from 619-011 instead of reprinting its own.

311-04.title: ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE

signs.note: Order and legend text are both sheet-driven. The XX/YY legend substitution from Table 311-03 is what disambiguates SignLibrary variants — do not resolve a distance-vs-AHEAD variant by guessing.

items.positionNote: Furthest upstream of the three advance warning signs.
items.signLibraryNote: SignLibrary key = base + legend suffix. 'W20-01R' is the Work (ROAD) family — the R here means ROAD, not Right (contrast W20-05R where R means Right). Suffix from the Table 311-03 XX value: AHEAD -> A, a feet distance -> F, a mile distance -> M. URBAN >= 45 MPH gives 'ROAD WORK 1000 FT.' -> W20-01RF; URBAN <= 40 MPH gives 'ROAD WORK AHEAD' -> W20-01RA.

SignLibrary key = base + legend suffix. 'W20-05R' is Closed (Lane) (Right). Suffix from the Table 311-03 YY value: AHEAD -> A, feet -> F, mile -> M. All URBAN bands give 'AHEAD' -> W20-05RA; RURAL gives '1000 FT.' -> W20-05RF.

items.positionNote: Closest advance warning sign to the taper.
Downstream of the work area, 80-400 ft past the end of the downstream taper.
items.labelNote: Two-line roadside label like every other MUTCD sign: code above, size below (G20-02 then 36" x 18"). Face already carries END ROAD WORK — that is the legend on the cell, not a substitute for the code/size callout. Live 2026-08-10: size-only label was wrong (engineer hand-fixed on Y=299000).
items.faceSymbologyNote: Correct face stack (engineer reference next to Y=297000 build): black lettering, orange field, black inner 'grouped hole' (SF_P nested cell color=240), orange outer border (SF_P complex color=6). Library place can leave the SF_P hole at color=6; DrawSign.FixG20FaceBlackHole forces it to 240 after place. Do not paint the whole face Color=0/6 via set_sign_attributes.

items.signLibraryNote: This is a VEHICLE-MOUNTED sign, not a roadside post-mounted advance warning sign. On the plan it is a leader callout pointing at the protective vehicle. A missing SignLibrary post-mounted entry for NYW8-33 is therefore NOT a gap that blocks this sheet — do not place it on a post.

items.note: Two flags per sign, at the upper corners. Shown on W20-1 and W4-2R only; W20-5R and G20-2 have no flags on this sheet.

items.stationAnchorNote: At the junction of the LANE TAPER and the SHOULDER TAPER, i.e. the upstream end of the lane taper. NOT at the upstream end of the shoulder taper.
items.lateralAnchor: On the paved shoulder, outboard of the closed travel lane
items.mountingStyleNote: Stem line + panel cell via place_cell_on_post (no TWZSGN_P post cell — that stacks on the tip cone and reads as a doubled orange marker). Base (x,y) is the station PERP TIP (alignment + outward*half_len, half_len=40 matching place_order_table_stations), NOT the alignment centerline. Live miss 2026-08-10: centerline base put stem/face/label ~40-50 ft short of the diamond-sign Y axis. Do not place TWZSGN_P at the channelizing tip.

alternative.description: A 24000 LB PROTECTIVE VEHICLE WITH TMIA carrying the arrow panel may be used instead of the trailer-mounted arrow panel, at the same station.

items.stationAnchorNote: FRONT of the vehicle at the upstream end of the roll ahead distance, so the full roll ahead distance is clear ahead of it toward the work area. Verified from the vector layer: the roll ahead dimension ends at y=303.2 and the vehicle body spans y 304.7-348.5, i.e. the dimension meets the vehicle's downstream (front) end. The vehicle's own length is drawn but not dimensioned on the sheet.
items.lateralAnchor: In the closed travel lane, parallel to traffic, front wheels aligned with the lane striping (Note 3)

items.required: only when the truck-mounted arrow panel option is used, or when Table 311-01 requires a protective vehicle for the closed shoulder
items.lateralAnchor: On the paved shoulder / outer edge of the closed lane at the head of the taper

representation.fillModeNote: ExecPlaceChannelizingMarkers must CreateShapeElement1(..., FillMode=0). Default fill=1 drew solid orange + outline and read as 'double rendering' even with XY dedup (live 2026-08-10).

longitudinalSpacing.sheetText: RECOMMENDED CONE SPACING NOT TO EXCEED 40 FT

runs.note: Continues along the longitudinal channelizing device line past the buffer space, the roll ahead distance and the work area.

DIAGONAL taper, not a flat row. Align 2 travels opposite align 1 so the same outward_sign points at the open side in world XY — a constant +lane_width landed every cone on the opposite side of centerline from roll-ahead. Compiler interpolates work-end offset=-lane_width (match roll-ahead world Y) to far-end offset=+lane_width (prior last-cone Y). First cone must share roll-ahead Y; last cone at far lateral; middle on the diagonal (engineer QA 2026-08-10).

items.runsSharedBoundaryNote: Adjacent runs share their boundary station by construction (e.g. shoulderTaperRun/laneTaperRun meet at the taper-continuity point, laneTaperRun/longitudinalRun meet at the bufferSpace/workArea edge). Real bug found live 2026-08-10: sheet_compile.compile_channelizing used to place one device from EACH run's endpoint-inclusive station list at that shared point, stacking two markers on top of each other ('two sets of channelizing devices'). Fixed with a placed-points dedup keyed on physical (x, y), not station number, so the second run's shared endpoint is skipped.

10'-0" (MIN.) from centerline to the longitudinal channelizing device line

printed: 1. SHORT-TERM STATIONARY IS DAYTIME WORK THAT OCCUPIES A LOCATION FOR MORE THAN 1 HOUR WITHIN A SINGLE DAYLIGHT PERIOD.
2. IN URBAN CONDITIONS, ADVANCE WARNING SIGN SPACINGS MAY BE ADJUSTED IN ORDER TO ACCOMMODATE SIDE STREETS AND DRIVEWAYS. IF THERE IS A CONFLICT, MOVE THE SIGN UPSTREAM.

3. THE PROTECTIVE VEHICLE(S) SHALL MAINTAIN THE APPROPRIATE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE, BE AN UNOCCUPIED TRUCK POSITIONED PARALLEL TO TRAFFIC, PARKING BRAKE SET, PLACED IN 2ND GEAR (MANUAL TRANSMISSIONS /ENGINE OFF) OR PARK / NEUTRAL (AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS) AND HAVE THE FRONT WHEELS ALIGNED WITH THE LANE STRIPING.
4. THERE SHALL BE NO WORKERS, EQUIPMENT OR OTHER VEHICLES IN THE BUFFER SPACE OR THE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE.
5. CHANNELIZING DEVICES SHALL BE PLACED TRANSVERSELY A MINIMUM OF EVERY 800' AS SHOWN WHEN A PAVED SHOULDER HAVING A WIDTH OF 8' OR GREATER IS CLOSED FOR A DISTANCE GREATER THAN 800'.

rules.assert: No work area hatch, protective vehicle, equipment or other symbol may overlap the bufferSpace or rollAheadDistance zones.
rules.commonFailure: Drawing the work area hatch from station 0 through the roll ahead distance.

rules.assert: The WORK AREA lies on the opposite side of station 0 from the upstream order-table walk. It must not occupy any upstream station.
rules.commonFailure: Using the Vehicle Space or Roll Ahead station as the work area extent.

rules.assert: Walking upstream from the shoulder taper, advance warning signs must appear in the order W4-2R, then W20-5R, then W20-1.
rules.commonFailure: Placing W20-1 nearest the taper and W4-2R furthest upstream (reversed).

rules.assert: Advance warning sign spacings A/B/C come from Table 311-03 keyed on areaType and preconstruction posted speed. They are equal to each other on this sheet.
rules.commonFailure: Using a fixed 350 ft default regardless of area type and speed.

rules.assert: W20-1 legend is 'ROAD WORK ' + XX and W20-5R legend is 'RIGHT LANE CLOSED ' + YY, with XX/YY read from Table 311-03.
rules.commonFailure: Choosing a SignLibrary distance variant by guessing instead of reading XX/YY.

rules.assert: The arrow panel sits at the upstream end of the LANE TAPER, on the shoulder — the same station where the shoulder taper begins.
rules.commonFailure: Anchoring it at the upstream end of the shoulder taper, one full shoulder-taper length too far upstream.

rules.assert: The shoulder taper and the lane taper form one continuous channelizing device line; they share the point at the travel-lane/shoulder edge with no lateral jog.
rules.commonFailure: Ending the shoulder taper at a fractional lane offset while the lane taper starts at zero offset.

rules.assert: The upstream station walk contains exactly: Roll Ahead Distance, Buffer Space, Lane Taper, then the three advance warning signs. No Vehicle Space, no temporary barrier, no box/corrugated beam row, and no Shoulder Taper row.
rules.commonFailure: Emitting the generic 7-row default upstream table for every sheet.

rules.assert: The shoulder taper starts where the lane taper ends and runs upstream INSIDE gap A. It consumes no station of its own; gap A is measured from the lane-taper/shoulder-taper junction to the first advance sign.
rules.commonFailure: Treating the shoulder taper as a sequential station row, which pushes every advance warning sign upstream by L/3.

rules.assert: G20-2 is placed on the downstream alignment, 80-400 ft past the end of the downstream taper.
rules.commonFailure: Placing G20-2 on the upstream alignment beyond the advance warning signs.

rules.assert: Roll ahead distance is a MIN/MAX range; the chosen value must be inside it and recorded.
rules.commonFailure: Treating one endpoint as the only value.

rules.assert: Preconstruction posted speed must be one of 25/30/35/40/45/50/55 for this sheet.
rules.commonFailure: Accepting 60 or 65 mph and extrapolating a taper length.

rules.assert: Shoulder widths of 8 ft and above all use the '>= 8 ft' column. No distinct 9/10/11/12 ft values exist.
rules.commonFailure: Inventing per-foot shoulder taper lengths above 8 ft.

rules.assert: Longitudinal channelizing device spacing must not exceed 40 ft.
rules.commonFailure: Drawing a bare polyline with no spacing annotation or device count.

rules.assert: At least 10'-0" of open travel lane must remain between the roadway centerline and the longitudinal channelizing device line.
rules.commonFailure: Offsetting the device line by a full lane width without checking the remaining open lane.

rules.assert: NYW8-33 'LANE CLOSED' is mounted on the protective vehicle, not on a roadside post.
rules.commonFailure: Reporting NYW8-33 as a blocking SignLibrary gap for post-mounted placement.

rules.assert: When a paved shoulder 8 ft or wider is closed for more than 800 ft, place transverse channelizing devices at least every 800 ft.
rules.commonFailure: Omitting Detail 311A entirely on long shoulder closures.

knownCodeDeviations.issue: Returns the same 7 upstream rows for every sheet, including Vehicle Space, Upstream Taper Temp Barrier and Upstream Taper Box/Corr Beam, none of which are on 619-311.
Defines distinct per-foot shoulder taper lengths for 8/9/10/11/12 ft. Table 311-02 has a single '>= 8 ft' column.
Computes 515/620/720/825/930/1030/1135/1365 by speed. These match no table on this sheet and the value is never consumed. Table 311-03 is 100/200/350/500 by area type.
Flat 350 ft default for every sign.
Emits a single value (120/160/200) with no min/max. Table 311-04 is a range.
Builds the work area from path start to the Vehicle Space station, placing the hatch inside the roll ahead distance.
Anchors the arrow panel at the Shoulder Taper station and both symbols at the perp tick tip (PERP_HALF_LEN = 40 ft off the alignment).
Ends the shoulder taper run at 0.35 * laneWidth while the lane taper run starts at zero offset, leaving a lateral jog; no device spacing or count.
The 619-311 elements field is six tokens with no geometry, ordering, or annotation semantics. This spec supersedes it for 619-311.
